actions.new_monitoring: Four fixed-code CloudWatch log metric filters, four actionless alarms and one dashboard; these alarm states do not send notifications.
actions.api: Update the existing ECS service desired count 0 to 1; replace its task definition with the approved image and enable the bounded test notification worker using the two existing private controlled recipients.
actions.task_definition_replacement: The saved plan deletes/deregisters the existing ECS task definition revision 10 and creates a new one. This is the only planned existing-resource delete/replacement and requires explicit approval. The existing service has zero running tasks.
actions.https: Create one t3.micro HTTPS proxy, EIP and association, dedicated limited SSM role/profile/policy, proxy security group and a narrow proxy-to-API port 18000 ingress rule. Proxy exposes only ports 80 and 443 publicly. Its upstream is existing private host 10.64.1.7. DNS A record change is separate.
actions.iam: Update only the existing SES FromAddress condition to include updates@clip-iisc.site alongside verify@clip-iisc.site; other Identity email policy statements are unchanged.
actions.preserved: No ASG, existing host, RDS, NAT, database secret, provider configuration or existing cloud data change is in the Terraform plan. Host scale-in protection is preserved.

ses: SSM email route was separately approved and changed to SES-first version 2; Resend key and fallback retained. Actual sends remain separately approved.
cost_and_bounds: Existing t3.micro host and db.t4g.micro total approximately USD 0.0322/hour compute; new t3.micro proxy approximately USD 0.0112/hour. EIP, EBS, NAT/data, logs, metrics, alarms, dashboard and taxes are additional. The USD 3 incremental operator stop threshold and 2026-10-30 10:30 UTC deadline are not hard billing caps; all resources remain running until user approves cleanup.
security: Test mode only; one task, a serial worker, existing controlled-recipient allowlist, 15-minute reminder, bounded retries and private database roles. HTTPS proxy has public TCP 80/443; it has no database/secret permissions. Verify image, readiness, logs and exact target after apply.
recovery: Stop on drift, failed apply or changed checksum; inspect state before retry. Old task definition deregistration is explicitly disclosed. No automatic rollback/reset or destruction of test resources is authorized. Separate user approval is required before cleanup, shutdown, DNS change or real test sends.
approval: Explicit approval of the exact saved Terraform plan SHA-256 and the disclosed task-definition deregistration is required before apply.
